_: GEMINI CLI. Merge into the settings used for IMPLEMENTATION sessions: <project>/.gemini/settings.json if the whole project is restricted, or a dedicated file (settings are layered system > user > project, so a project file wins for that workspace). The matcher is a REGEX over the tool name, so '.*' covers built-in, MCP and provider tools alike - the hook, not the matcher, decides what is forbidden. $GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR is exported to hook commands by Gemini CLI. Capability denial belongs in the policy engine (assets/gemini-policy.toml), not here: this file only wires the hook. If dirty-side subagents (investigator/verifier) run in the same project, they need CLEANROOM_ROLE=investigator|verifier in their environment - the hook then allows-and-logs their source reads.

hooks.name: cleanroom
hooks.description: Block and log encumbered-source access in clean-room implementation sessions.
